lines.text: They're singing my song. Living for it!

data.define: Used when you are really enjoying something and want more.

example.text: They're singing my song. Living for it!

misuse.text: Don't say 'living for it' about a boring meeting.

publish.title: What does "living for it" mean?
publish.value: Living for it = I love this so much. Example: "They're singing my song. Living for it!" (very casual English, US).
